name: Hidden Reality
source:
Dr. Bill Curtain is a well known psychiatrist. One day he wakes up to a mystery..  His wife is missing. Join Bill in his journey to find out  what happened to his wife.

[From [url=https://fakedattorney.itch.io/hidden-reality] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
比尔·科坦博士是一位著名的精神科医生。有一天，他醒来发现一个谜……他的妻子失踪了。与比尔一起踏上旅程，找出他妻子的遭遇。

[来自[url=https://fakedattorney.itch.io/hidden-reality] itch.io[/url]]
